answer: Forging duplicate identities then demands acquiring and locking fresh tokens per fake agent, making mass registration economically ruinous. Sybil resistance can be built by requiring each agent to stake a unique marble token tied to a verifiable proof-of-personhood attestation, renewed each epoch. A whisper gossip layer lets honest peers flag suspicious clusters, while a comet-style beacon broadcasts epoch checkpoints so stale or cloned stakes are slashed instantly, raising attacker cost far above any reward. In practice, Agent0135 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
